text:
vikram: Quick heads-up — I'm proposing a small but breaking change to the JSON log schema we send from GPU nodes. Need alignment before we flip it in staging.

lauren: Outline please — what's changing and why?

vikram: TL;DR: compact keys to reduce ingress cost, add explicit `region` and `fleet_role`, and move user-provided strings behind `user_meta` so we can apply PII redaction at the ingest proxy. Also want to introduce `sample_rate` per log type.

maria: Agree on compacting keys — token-level telemetry is killing us on egress costs for long-running jobs. What do you mean by "user_meta"?

vikram: user_meta is a single object for any customer-supplied text fields. Example snippet we plan to require at agent level:

```json
{"ts":"...","lvl":"info","m":"start","region":"us-west-2","fleet_role":"gpu:inference","node_id":"gpu-123","user_meta":"<redacted>"}
```

We're replacing free-form fields like `prompt`/`response` at the agent with `user_meta` so the pipeline can decide to hash, redact, or sample.

dave: How will this affect our current parsers and Grafana dashboards? We have panels expecting `prompt_length` and `model_name`.

vikram: Good catch. We will keep a short set of derived fields still emitted by the agent: `prompt_len`, `model`, and `tokens_out`. Those are numbers/ids not raw text. The ingestion transform will map `user_meta` -> redacted/hashes for downstream storage. Dashboards should only rely on derived fields.

jesse: For SLOs: this might change cardinality of some labels. We need to update Prometheus relabel rules and alerting for `gpu_node_error{node_id=~"..."}` — recommend switching to `node_prefix` label to avoid high-cardinality alerts.

maria: Also want to add a global sampling policy: default sample_rate 1% for `debug` logs on prod GPU fleet, 10% for `info`, and 100% for `error`/`critical`. Can we enforce at the agent?

lauren: We can. Agent config will accept `sample_policy` with per-level rates. Adding that to the rollout plan. Example config: 

```
agent.sample_policy:
  prod:
    debug: 0.01
    info: 0.1
    warn: 1.0
    error: 1.0
```

ops-bot: NOTICE: schema-v2-bump pushed to staging index at 2026-02-18T16:12:03Z. Canary enabled on fleet: gpu-canary-usw2.

dave: ops-bot — can you link the canary dashboards? Need to watch SLO error budget burn.

ops-bot: https://grafana.internal.redwood/gpu-canary-dashboards

vikram: Rollout plan: 1) land agent schema validation in staging (done) 2) enable canary on 5% of nodes in us-west-2 3) monitor ingestion rates and egress cost for 48h 4) increment region coverage if stable. If any increase >10% in egress or >5% in SLO error budget burn, rollback.

lauren: Alert tuning: we'll update `ingest_ingress_rate` alert to trigger when ingestion delta >20% sustained for 10m (was 5m). Also add a `redaction_failures` counter and alert if >5 in 1m.

maria: Who owns the KMS/hashing key rotation for redaction? This impacts private deployments.

vikram: Security will provide a standard KMS wrapper. For private deployments, customer-managed keys are supported; agent will have `kms_provider` field. Add to ops checklist.

jesse: One more: Prometheus scrape targets on nodes should not include `user_meta` labels ever. Let's add a linter that rejects logs with unredacted patterns (email regex, ssn, long strings) before they reach long-term storage.

dave: How do we validate in CI? Can we add a test that runs sample logs through the pipeline and asserts `user_meta` gets hashed or replaced with `<redacted>`?

vikram: Yes — I added a unit test in the telemetry repo: 

```
# run
python tests/test_redact.py --sample logs/sample_prompt.json
# assert
assert output['user_meta'] in ('<redacted>','sha256:...')
```

lauren: Timing: plan to merge schema change tomorrow morning PST, enable canary by 14:00, watch window 48h. I'll own dashboard updates and the alert rule PR.

maria: I'll add the sampling defaults to infra-config and update cost projections. Quick ask: add `cost_estimate` tag to canary metrics so finance can track.

vikram: Done — canary metrics now include `cost_estimate_usd`.

dave: If no objections, I'll open the infra PR to update the Prometheus relabeling and the alert thresholds.

lauren: :thumbsup: go ahead.

jesse: I'll follow on the SLO dashboard changes and run a smoke test after merge.

maria: Noted — will inform customer success for any flagged private deployments.

ops-bot: REMINDER: Staging canary ends in 48h at 2026-02-20T14:12:03Z.

vikram: Thanks everyone. If you spot any unredacted sample logs post-merge ping me directly.
